sliver_scan._doc: GENERATED by --parse and re-derived by --check. The column-boundary pairs this reading offers, how many are byte-exact slivers under the T-0601 rule, and the closest pair that is not one. A zero in `byte_exact` means nothing on its own for an OCR reading, where the two readings of the overlap cannot be byte-identical; `max_prefix_agreement` is what says whether there was anything to find. See the comment above scan_slivers() (T-0810).
